name: Custom Power Menu Shortcuts
description: Adds Shut down, Restart, Sleep, Lock and Sign out shortcuts to your Start menu (and optionally the desktop).
author: AETHER

settings.label: Sleep
settings.description: If hibernation is enabled, Windows hibernates instead of sleeping.

settings.label: Also place shortcuts on the desktop

documentation.whatItChanges: Creates .lnk files in Start Menu\Programs\AETHER Power (and the desktop if chosen).
documentation.uninstall: The shortcuts AETHER created are deleted.
